name: Phong Shading with SDF Normals
definition: A shading model that calculates lighting contributions by looping over lights and accumulating terms based on the Phong reflection model, using normals approximated from the SDF gradient.
summary: Phong Shading with SDF Normals is a volume rendering lighting model that computes surface normals via SDF gradients to apply Phong reflection, distinguishing itself by using exact reflected light vectors rather than half-vector approximations.
